cars.variant: MT900S LS7 — 2008 Lightning Lap test reference
cars.specification_market: Selected 2008 MT900S LS7 configuration described in Car and Driver Lightning Lap. Four test-report attributes retain LS7 V8, 550 hp as published and 2584 lb test-car weight without inferring power standard, rpm, torque or mass measurement basis. Two programme-construction attributes use the explicitly named standard MT900S road monocoque and subframes in Mosler Europe 2007 GT3 sheet; no blanket transfer of other GT3 equipment. Separate 2006 firsthand article reports production road deliveries/certification and explicitly distinguishes its modified supercharged 600-hp test car from the 405-hp road base. Neither that tuned result nor the 2001 prototype specifications are this selected 2008 reference. No exact displacement, induction, gearbox, brakes, dimensions, speed/lap time or racing result inferred. One original road family across years/engines; no GT3/MT900R, prototype, replica or additional package count. 2007-labelled representative photo does not authenticate selected test chassis, engine tune, model year or originality.
cars.summary: The MT900S earns its place through focused lightweight supercar engineering and the exceptional capability documented in Car and Driver’s own 2008 circuit test. Its LS7 V8 road-car package represents a developed performance programme rather than rarity alone. Count the original MT900 road family once; prototypes and racing derivatives do not become additional entries.

sources.title: Lightning Lap 2008 — MT900S section
sources.notes: Relevant complete Mosler section and test context read. Four attributes retain the writer-reported test-car LS7 V8, output and weight; no dyno measurement, horsepower standard or curb/dry measurement basis assumed. No lap number inferred from an uninspected chart and no subjective potential counted as a measured result. The described adjustment and wheel-weight problem limit the session; this is not certification of every car.

sources.title: 2006 Mosler MT900S — road test, 1 April 2006
sources.source_type: Original firsthand road-test and factory interview report
sources.notes: Complete relevant article body read. Used for production-road versus prototype/modified-test identity only. Reports road deliveries and EPA/DOT certification; underlying government certificates not independently read and current registration is not authenticated. Explicitly says its 600-hp tested car gained an aftermarket supercharger after federal tests; no acceleration, skidpad, weight or brakes transferred to selected 2008 LS7 car. Earlier 2001 prototype data and exclusive record claims not imported.

sources.publisher: Mosler Europe / Rollcentre; original sheet preserved by All Car Central
sources.title: Mosler MT900GT3 — Technical Specifications 2007; explicit standard road chassis passage
sources.source_type: Original manufacturer technical sheet, third-party-hosted copy
sources.notes: Single-page original technical sheet downloaded, extracted, fully rendered and actually viewed. Mosler Europe footer and 2007 heading read. It explicitly calls the GT3 a non-road-legal modification of the MT900S road car and names the standard road monocoque/subframes. Only those two explicitly identified road components are used. The general standard-components clause is not treated as permission to transfer GT3 engine mapping, sequential gearbox, racing brakes, roll cage, fuel cell, dimensions, weight, aero, tyres or interior.
